note: External injury reporting, gathered by web research on 2026-08-25 because projection sources lag injury news independently of one another. player_id is the SLEEPER id (the crosswalk key that ReviewInputs, playing_time.json and projection_decisions.json all use) -- NOT PoolPlayer.player_id, which is FFC-derived and a different number for the same man. Every entry carries the date and URL of the newest report behind it; an entry with no citation is refused by the loader. RE-RUN THIS RESEARCH after the Aug 30 53-man cutdown: active/PUP either clears or converts to reserve/PUP (a four-game minimum), and that single transaction moves three of these five players. SCHEMA NOTE (2026-08-27): 'games_missed' may be null, meaning UNPRICED -- something is known and no honest games figure exists for it (an open disciplinary review has no timeline). That is NOT the same as 0, which is a positive claim that he plays a full season. An unpriced finding changes no number anywhere; the board renders it as a RISK badge so the judgement is visible in the room instead of sitting in this file. See backend/draftroom/valuation/injury_research.py.

findings.notes: Torn/damaged PCL, re-aggravated in the first week of camp; surgery Aug 1. GM John Lynch confirmed season-ending on the record. Straight IR, NOT 'IR designated to return'. 6-12 month recovery. SF signed Deebo Samuel in response.

Torn ACL in a joint practice with the Raiders on Aug 18-19; placed on season-ending IR Aug 19-20, confirmed by Schefter. THIS IS THE LAG CASE: it happened after our ESPN cache of Aug 18, so any pool built before Aug 19 has him healthy.

Left ankle/heel surgery late March, 4-6 month rehab plus a second PRP injection; has not practiced at all in camp as of Aug 25. Steichen and Ballard both still say Week 1. RANGE IS 0-1 games if he is activated before the Aug 30 cutdown, 4-5 minimum if he converts to reserve/PUP. The 4 recorded here is the reserve/PUP floor, i.e. the pessimistic branch; re-check on Aug 31.

Torn ACL in the divisional round, surgery Feb 20. First low-impact agility work in front of media ~Aug 21-23; no practice, no preseason snaps. ESPN's Brady Henderson reported he may not return until late in the season; medical reads have him below 100% until at least November. Range 4-13, midpoint 10. Separate ROLE risk that is NOT an availability question: Seattle drafted Jadarian Price 32nd overall and he is establishing himself as the lead back.

Hamstring in a joint practice with Jacksonville on Aug 13; Garafolo/Rapoport report roughly two months, i.e. mid-October. Our feed says only 'Doubtful', a game-week label being used for a two-month absence. Range 4-6. Saints have until Aug 30 5pm CT to decide on IR.
